svg.aria-label: Four kinds of information leakage. Target leakage: a column made from the outcome, such as catch weight when predicting a count; drop columns made from the outcome. Group leakage: the same unit in training and test, such as repeat visits to one site; split by the unit, by site. Selection leakage: columns chosen by looking at all rows, such as keeping the ten best correlated; choose using training rows only. Preprocessing leakage: numbers worked out from all rows, such as a median used to fill gaps; put every step in a recipe. Each lets the test set shape the model before it is tested.
svg.text: a column made from the outcome,
